title: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
abstract: arXiv:2610.27045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world mode

translated_title: 物理人工智能：概念、技术与挑战
translated_abstract: 近年来，物理人工智能发展迅速，在学术界和工业界引起了广泛关注。然而，该领域在其定义、技术版图和核心挑战方面尚未达成共识。为弥补这一空白，本专著旨在对物理AI进行定义，呈现其技术版图，并深入研究各个关键技术子领域。在此过程中，本专著建立了物理AI的统一框架：即人工系统在真实世界约束下，通过持续反馈来感知、建模并作用于物理世界。此外，本专著将物理AI与传统的数字AI、具身智能、信息物理系统以及数字孪生进行了区分。它从物理学、控制、认知、学习与推理等方面构建了物理AI的理论基础，并综述了关键方法论，包括多模态感知、物理数据与仿真、世界模型等。
tldr: 本专著首次为物理人工智能提出了统一定义与技术框架，将其与数字AI、具身智能、信息物理系统和数字孪生等领域明确区分，并系统梳理了其在物理学、控制、认知、学习与推理方面的理论基础及关键方法论。
en_tdlr: This monograph establishes the first unified definition and technical framework for physical AI, clearly distinguishes it from digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins, and systematically reviews its foundations in physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning, along with key methodologies.
